# Extensions on validation and test (generated by `scripts/run_extensions_xgb.py`)

Git commit `1942227baf`. Secondary, exploratory results; recipe identical for all sets (ratio target, stage-2 hyper-parameters of the horizon, early stopping on validation, 3 seeds, mean prediction). Differences are MAE(set) minus MAE(S2_ref) in MW with 95% block-bootstrap intervals (negative = the extra features help). Forecast-weather caveat: the archive's 'previous_dayN' values are treated as available at the forecast origin; their exact issue time was not verified, so they may be slightly optimistic.

## Horizon 1 h

Share of training / validation target hours with no archived forecast: S6_forecastC: 0.2% / 10.3%; S8_both: 0.2% / 10.3% (XGBoost handles the gaps as missing values).

| set | validation MAE | vs S2_ref (95% CI) | test MAE | vs S2_ref (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| S2_ref | 1,071 | - | 1,089 | - |
| S6_forecastC | 1,082 | +11 (+4 to +19) | 1,099 | +10 (+4 to +17) |
| S7_regionalFest | 1,074 | +3 (-1 to +7) | 1,093 | +5 (+2 to +7) |
| S8_both | 1,080 | +9 (+3 to +15) | 1,100 | +11 (+4 to +18) |
